goal: Ship a new, additive UI surface at /lab that proves out a redesigned capture-trust loop, standalone entity authoring, and a people/load rollup against real live data — without modifying any existing route, component, or API behavior, so the current app remains the permanent default and fallback.
userProblem: Capture applies changes silently with no visible reasoning, so messy input isn't trusted enough to be captured regularly; entities have no manual 'add relationship' affordance (only remove exists); and seeing who's carrying what work requires opening each person's page one at a time. A disposable clickable prototype validated a redesigned shell for these gaps; this PRD builds the real, additive version of it.
whyNow: UX interview + prototype review on 2026-07-05/06 confirmed the core primitives (capture, reconciliation, entity linking, per-person meeting prep/load) already work; the gap is visibility/trust framing plus two small aggregate capabilities. Product decision locked 2026-07-06: build at /lab inside the existing ui/ app, additive-only, real live data (not sandboxed), explicitly excluding multi-person/group meeting prep.

dataOrApiDependencies: Tests must use TEST_DATABASE_URL on port 5433 only.
No schema migrations — EntityLink table already supports the manual-link use case.
Lab reads/writes the same live data as the current app; snapshot via scripts/backup_prod.sh before any deploy from LAB-01 onward, per V4_PRINCIPLES.md.

Any new fields added to the capture response (LAB-01) must be additive only — a contract test must assert existing fields/shape are unchanged, since V5CaptureSheet/V5ReviewSheet consume the same endpoint.
writePathsAffected: None until LAB-01 (capture apply/undo — reuses existing apply + revert code paths)
New: manual EntityLink creation via POST /api/v4/entities/:id/links (LAB-02)

tasks.title: Capture trust loop wired to real data
tasks.description: Build LabCapture.jsx sheet wired to real POST /api/v4/capture (mode: auto), rendering applied_changes/suggestions as a review-then-receipt flow (auto-applied items show match reasoning + confidence; ambiguous items are resolvable inline; commit transitions to a receipt with per-item Undo). Backend: before adding anything, inspect _capture_result_payload in api/v4_entities.py to see what reasoning/confidence fields already exist from Iteration 19 signal-quality work. Only add missing fields (e.g. reason, match_confidence, matched_entity) to applied_changes/suggestions items, additively — never rename or remove an existing field. Undo reuses the existing GET /api/v4/entities/:id/capture-changes + POST /api/v4/events/:id/revert pair (already shipped, Slice B3) — no new revert logic.
acceptanceCriteria: A contract test asserts every field present in the capture response before this task is still present and unchanged in shape/type after — protects V5CaptureSheet/V5ReviewSheet, which consume the same endpoint.
Real capture of a fixture note in Lab shows auto-applied items with visible match reasoning, ambiguous items resolvable inline, and a receipt with working per-item Undo.
Existing capture/suggestions integration suites still pass unmodified in behavior (only additive assertions added).

tasks.title: Entity authoring: inline edit + manual relationship add
tasks.description: Build LabEntityDetail.jsx wired to the existing entity-detail GET and existing update-entity PATCH (already used by current UI's edit mode) for status/priority/date. Add a new additive endpoint POST /api/v4/entities/:id/links with body { target_id, relationship_type }, reusing the existing _create_entity_link helper in api/v4_entities.py. Add request validation: relationship_type must be in the V4_PRINCIPLES.md allowed list, entity-type compatibility must hold, and blocks-cycle creation must be rejected by reusing the existing cycle-detection logic from the Phase C4 delegation work. Recorded actor/source must be manual/user, not agent:*. The "+ add" picker in the UI calls the existing hybrid search endpoint for candidate lookup, then the new link endpoint on selection.
acceptanceCriteria: New endpoint has unit + integration tests written first: valid link creates an EntityLink row; invalid relationship_type rejected with a clear error; cyclic blocks link rejected; existing _create_entity_link callers unaffected.
In Lab, editing status/priority/date on a real task persists and is reflected on that same entity's page in the current app.
Adding a relationship via the "+ add" picker creates a real EntityLink, visible as a chip in both Lab and the current app.
New tests/integration/test_v4_entity_links.py and npm test -- LabEntityDetail both green.

tasks.title: People rollup (single-person data only, no group merge)
tasks.description: Build LabPeople.jsx: a list of people showing open-task count, last-heard timestamp, and a gone-quiet flag, reusing the existing delegation-cadence logic (_person_pulse / _delegation_cadence_days) already computed for Today's 'needs a nudge' section. Prefer assembling this from existing /api/v4/entities?type=person plus each person's existing detail payload; only add a new additive GET /api/v4/people/load-summary batch endpoint if N+1 calls are measured to be too slow — do not pre-optimize. Clicking a person opens their existing single-person detail (meeting prep + current load) unchanged. Do not build multi-select, group meeting prep, or any cross-person aggregation — explicitly cut from this iteration's scope.
acceptanceCriteria: People list in Lab shows real load/last-heard/quiet-flag for every real person, computed from real data.
No multi-select UI exists on this screen.
If a batch endpoint was added, it is additive-only and a perf comparison against N+1 is recorded before being kept.
npm test -- LabPeople green; relevant backend suite green if a new endpoint was added.
